signatures.description: Implement a t-digest that streams million-scale heavy-tailed samples online and must guarantee k-size-monotone cluster boundaries so that digest merge stays order-independent within a stated error bound. The failure mode to handle is the error cliff: after merging two digests with different delta settings, the centroid count collapses and the 0.999 quantile error jumps from 0.1% to 5% unless cluster merging respects the scaled k1/k2 size function on the union rather than re-clustering naively. Verify with a Kolmogorov-Smirnov test against the exact quantile function on a Pareto(1.05) stream.
